---
title: "Lecture library"
subtitle: "Every lecture of ES 335 Machine learning, August to November 2025, with its slides, notebooks, cheat sheet and short videos."
---

Each row is one lecture, grouped by part of the course. The slide handouts and notebooks are from
[ml-teaching](https://github.com/nipunbatra/ml-teaching), which also lists [all slides](https://nipunbatra.github.io/ml-teaching/slides.html)
and [all notebooks](https://nipunbatra.github.io/ml-teaching/notebooks.html). The Shorts are also collected, in course
order, on the [Machine learning in 1 minute](https://nipunbatra.github.io/ml-in-1-minute.html) page and in a
[YouTube playlist](https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLNKjEaQxBYLU).

[**Slides**: lecture handouts (PDF) · **Notebooks**: worked code · **Apps**: interactive demos ·
**Cheat sheet**: a two-page A4 summary (PDF) · **Shorts**: one-minute videos, each answering one question; point at a
number to see the question.]{.res-key}

::: {.lecture-library}
